name: Properties in PDF Export
changes: An edit of Folder layouts without Pro now shows how to get Pro, with a Sponsor on GitHub button. Before, the text saved but had no effect. Nothing is saved until Pro is on.
tip: In reading view, run "Toggle printable header preview" to check the header before you export to PDF.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Properties in PDF Export is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it for the documents you share.
